newsitems.title: [PC][Global] Scheduled Maintenance 16MAR2016 @ 10:00AM EST
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
We will be performing scheduled maintenance on Wednesday, March 16th. Online services for the PC client will be unavailable between 10:00AM - 11:00AM EST.

We will be applying a small hotfix during this time. The details of which can be found below.

[b]IP Protection[/b]
As previously mentioned in update 2.2, we have been working on IP protection in order to help protect our players’ information. During the upcoming maintenance, we will be implementing a fix that will prevent players from being able to access IP information of the opposing team’s players. While we believe this fix will be deployed without any issues, as a precaution we have added a switch that will revert the game back to its pre-patch state if an issue occurs. This precautionary switch will boot players from the game for a short period of time if activated. We will make sure to communicate this prior to the short downtime if we do decide to activate the switch.

[b]PC Crash Fix[/b]
After the latest UplayPC update, some PC players were experiencing in game crashes more frequently than usual. We have identified the cause of this issue and our team will be deploying a fix during the upcoming maintenance.

Thank you for your patience!

newsitems.title: Black Ice is now Live!
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
[IMG]http://static2.ubi.com/pxm/RainbowSix/RB6_BlackICe_KeyArt_Final.jpg[/IMG]

Today, we're proud to announce the official launch of Season One with the release of our first major content update, [B]Operation Black Ice[/B].

Operation Black Ice brings with it a slew of new content, including the introduction of two brand new operators, Frost and Buck. Bringing with them new weapons and gadgets, including the "Welcome Mat" trap and the "Skeleton Key" under-barrel shotgun, they'll surely help with expanding your attacking and defending options. These options will be sorely needed when tackling our new map, the Yacht. 

Currently moored in Baffin Bay, this luxurious yacht has struck an iceberg and has been breached. As part of Team Rainbow, you're being sent in to help secure the stranded vessel, as an unidentified submarine has been seen docked close by.

Operation Black Ice also brings with it the Spectator Camera, which is now available online and on all platforms. The Spectator Camera allows players to create custom 5v5 multiplayer games, with an 11th player observing the match in real time. Spectator Cam also introduces a brand new way to see the field of operation with the Tactical View. This view allows players to select and follow individual players, or use it's "free-cam" to observe the map as a whole. We hope that the Spectator Cam will not only give a brand new way to watch games play out, but also helps new players learn more about the game.

In addition to these brand new features, we're adding a bunch of balancing, player comfort and playlist changes in this update. We not only believe that these changes will help improve the overall game experience for everyone, but that these should help with issues that some of you have been experiencing.

NEW CONTENT UPDATE
[LIST]
[*]New Operators
[*]New map
[*]New feature
[/LIST]
GENERAL TWEAKS & IMPROVEMENTS
[LIST]
[*]Playlist changes
[*]Balancing
[*]Player comfort
[*]Web improvements
[/LIST]
MAIN BUG FIXES
[LIST]
[*]Gameplay fixes
[*]Level Design fixes
[*]Online fixes
[*]UI fixes
[*]Miscellaneous fixes
[/LIST]
For a full list of changes and additions being made with the start of Season One, including the introduction of the Black Ice Weapon Skin Collection, please head over to the [URL=www.rainbow6.com/BlackIce]Black Ice webpage[/URL].

Thank you for being part of this with us and sharing your feedback. We hope you enjoy the new content Season One brings and are looking forward to sharing more improvements on the game with you. 

[I]The Rainbow Six Siege Development Team[/I]

newsitems.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.3
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
[B]In-Depth Patch Notes - Update 1.3 - January 13th (PC) & January 20th (Consoles)[/B]
 
Today we are sharing our third update. This one is smaller because we felt we needed to quickly fix some issues. The changes described below will take effect on January 13th for PC and on January 20th for consoles, [B]except[/B] the server tick rate improvement, the anti-cheating and banning policy improvements as well as the out-of-zone insta-kill option which is effective for all immediately (read below for details). This patch will be released on PC first because of the faster deployment process, in order to test the impact the fixes have and adjust if needed. Note that tomorrow, January 13th, [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1368508-Patch-Notes-Update-1-2]Patch 1.2[/URL] takes effect on consoles. A much bigger patch, Patch 2.0, will be released at the same time as Season 1, on February 2nd. This update will be made available on PC and consoles at the same time.

Please refer to our post about our [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1332624-Top-Priorities-and-Known-Issues-Updated-1-12-2016]top priorities and known issues[/URL] to see our current plans and steps we are taking to improve the game as we move forwards. Note that this update, Patch 1.3, will not fix all of our current top issues and that we are actively working on fixing them as soon as possible.
 
[B]GENERAL TWEAKS & IMPROVEMENTS[/B]
(Live for PC and consoles, as of Jan. 13th)

[B]HIT REGISTRATION IMPROVEMENTS [/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Updated the server tick rate for console users[/B]
[*]With the goal of improving positioning and shooting replication, we had deployed a first update on PC in which the player position update rate is set to 60 times per second (vs. the previous 30). After testing, we are satisfied with its state so we are now deploying this update to all consoles as well.
[/LIST]
[B]ANTI-CHEATING IMPROVEMENTS[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Cheating countermeasures have been improved further.[/B]
[*][B]Banning policy update: all cheaters detected by the system will be banned permanently.[/B] No more three day ban for first offense.
[/LIST]
[B]EXPLOIT FIX: DEFENDERS EXITING THE PREPARATION PHASE [/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Added a configuration that allows us to turn ON an insta-kill configuration for Defenders that go outside their zone during the preparation phase[/B] (this behavior should not be possible, but if exploits are found, the guilty shall be punished by a swift death!)
[*]We will be able to activate this functionality at any time. We will first be testing it on XB1 during the afternoon of January 13th (Montreal time). If it proves effective, we will be deploying this on all platforms later that day.
[/LIST]
[B]TOP COMMUNITY-RAISED BUG FIXES[/B]
(Live for PC on Jan. 13th, live for consoles on Jan. 20th)
Please be aware that this is not an exhaustive list and that we are only highlighting fixes that were done about the most commonly raised community bugs.
 
[B]LEVEL DESIGN FIXES[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Fixed a bug that allowed players to exit their zone during the preparation phase (red wall). [/B]When transitioning from proning to standing position combined with putting up a barricade, players were able to go through walls. We believe this exploit is now solved. Please share your experience in [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1370757-HIGH-PRIORITY-ISSUE-Defenders-Allowed-To-Go-Outside-During-Prep-Phase-(Red-Wall)]this forum thread[/URL] if you still encounter it after the patch (information we are looking for listed in opening post).
[/LIST]
[B]ONLINE FIXES [/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Partial fix of Error [2-0x00000041]. [/B]Refer to the High Priority Issues in the [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1332624-Top-Priorities-and-Known-Issues-Updated-1-7-2016?]Known Issues post[/URL] for more information.
[*][B]Potential full fix of the loading screen freeze (smoke background). [/B]Refer to the High Priority Issues in the [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1332624-Top-Priorities-and-Known-Issues-Updated-1-7-2016?]Known Issues post[/URL] for full information.
[*][B]Potential full fix of the failed data synchronization issue. [/B]Refer to the High Priority Issues in the [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1332624-Top-Priorities-and-Known-Issues-Updated-1-7-2016?]Known Issues post[/URL] for full information.
[*]Session authentication operation requests are now using the per data center proxy instead of the Dev one.
[*]Improved error tracking, for easier issue identification from our side.
[*]Ranked match reconnection fixes for PC:
[list]
[*]If game was closed by pressing [x] or ALT+F4, the players will not be leaving all sessions anymore.
[*]Players leaving a Ranked match by pressing F10 will now be receiving reconnect & abandon messages.
[*]Players leaving a Ranked match by quitting with ALT+F4 will now be receiving reconnect & abandon messages.
[/list]
[*]Various smaller connectivity and crash fixes.
[/LIST]
[I]The Rainbow Six Siege Development Team[/I]

newsitems.title: Patch Notes - Update 1.2
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
In-Depth Patch Notes - Update 1.2 - January 7th (PC)

Hello everyone! 

Today we are sharing our second title update. Keep in mind that we will be improving with every update. The changes described below will take effect on [B]January 7th 2016 for PC and on January 14th 2016 for Consoles[/B]. This patch will be released on PC first because of the faster deployment process, in order to test the impact the fixes have and adjust if needed. 

Please refer to our post about our [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1368504-January-2016-Priority-Fixing-Top-Issues]January 2016 Priority – Fixing Top Issues[/URL] to see our current plans and steps we are taking to improve the game. Note that this patch, Update 1.2, will not fix all of our current top issues and that we are actively working on fixing them as soon as possible. 


[B]General Tweaks and Improvements[/B]

[B]Hit Registration Improvements[/B]
[B]Updated the server tick rate for all PC users, coming soon to consoles[/B]
With the goal of improving positioning and shooting replication, we had deployed a first update on PC in which the player position update rate is set to 60 times per second (vs. the previous 30). This change however has been done in an intermittent fashion and in certain regions only, as we were testing various configurations. We are now satisfied with its state so we are now deploying this update to all PC users. As soon as this feature has been validated with this more massive test on PC, we will be deploying this update on consoles as soon as possible.

[B]Data center selection is now possible (PC users only, for now)[/B]
PC users can change their default data centers in the Rainbow Six game settings file (gamesettings.ini), which is usually located in the ‘My Documents\My Games\your Uplay ID’ folder. Change the DataCenterHint value from ‘default’ to the region’s short name that you wish to have as your default data center. The available region short names can be found just above the DataCenterHint line.

Note that we are planning to eventually expose this in the in-game UI for all platforms and this PC-exclusive feature is only a first step.


[B]Matchmaking Improvements[/B]
[LIST]
[B]Refining the quality of PVP matches with more evenly matched opponents[/B]
[*][B]Added a criteria that increases the odds of pre-made parties being matched against a squad with an equal number of pre-made parties within them.[/B]
[*]Skill criterion originating from the player’s region is now more precise. 
[/LIST]
[B]Improved connectivity to PVP and PVE matches[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Increased match quality by ensuring players using the same data center get matched together, leading to better ping.[/B]
[*]Improved accuracy of the estimated waiting time while in lobby. 
[/LIST]


[B]Top Community-Raised Bug Fixes[/B]
Please be aware that this is not an exhaustive list and that we are only highlighting fixes that were done about the most commonly raised community bugs.

[B]Gameplay Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Ranked matches HUD synch with Casual update has been applied (read: playlist changes from [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1355300-Patch-Notes-Update-1-1?]this post[/URL]).[/B]
[*]Did some fixes on an issue in which players would get stuck when walking, running or at the end of a rappel. The player could do other actions and rotate but couldn’t move.
[list]
[*]Some situations still cause this bug. It is a work in progress.
[/list]
[/LIST]
[B]Level Design Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Kanal: fixed a bug in which the red blocker wall was not present on a window in the holding room for Defenders and allowed them to exit their zone during the preparation phase.[/B]
[*]Some lighting issues on maps have been fixed.
[*]Some minor collision issues have been fixed on House, Clubhouse, Kanal and Russian Café.
[/LIST]
[B]Online Flow Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Fixed Error [3-0x0001000B].[/B]
[*][B]Partial fix of Error [2-0x00000041].[/B] Refer to Top Issues in the [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1332624-Top-Priorities-and-Known-Issues-Updated-1-7-2016]Known Issues[/URL] post for full information.
[*][B]Partial fix of the loading screen freeze (smoke background).[/B] Refer to Top Issues in the [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1332624-Top-Priorities-and-Known-Issues-Updated-1-7-2016]Known Issues[/URL] post for full information.
[/LIST]
[B]UI Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Player skill rank display has been re-activated.[/B]
[*]Authentication pop-up title had inconsistent spacing.
[/LIST]
[B]Audio Fixes[/B]

In-Depth Patch Notes - Update 1.2 - January 7th (PC)

Hello everyone! 

Today we are sharing our second title update. Keep in mind that we will be improving with every update. The changes described below will take effect on [B]January 7th 2016 for PC and on January 14th 2016 for Consoles[/B]. This patch will be released on PC first because of the faster deployment process, in order to test the impact the fixes have and adjust if needed. 

Please refer to our post about our [URL=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1368504-January-2016-Priority-Fixing-Top-Issues]January 2016 Priority – Fixing Top Issues[/URL] to see our current plans and steps we are taking to improve the game. Note that this patch, Update 1.2, will not fix all of our current top issues and that we are actively working on fixing them as soon as possible. 


[B]General Tweaks and Improvements[/B]

[B]Hit Registration Improvements[/B]
[B]Updated the server tick rate for all PC users, coming soon to consoles[/B]
With the goal of improving positioning and shooting replication, we had deployed a first update on PC in which the player position update rate is set to 60 times per second (vs. the previous 30). This change however has been done in an intermittent fashion and in certain regions only, as we were testing various configurations. newsitems.title: Rainbow Six Siege's Playlists to Evolve in the Coming Months
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
[img]http://static2.ubi.com/pxm/RainbowSix/Playlist%20article%20image%201.png[/img]

We’re thrilled to see the community’s reaction to the game since launch, and we’re also striving to consistently improve the online experience for all players. As discussed in our recent Reddit AMA, the team is hard at work in ironing out server and connectivity issues and will detail those improvements in an official set of patch notes next week.

Today, however, we’re excited to share details on how the settings of Rainbow Six Siege’s main PVP playlist, Casual and Rank, will be evolving in the short term as well as our intention to create a dedicated hardcore playlist with its own set of rules.


[b]MID-DECEMBER 2015: SYNCH BACK THE HUD OF CASUAL / RANKED PLAYLISTS.[/b] This will be done two weeks after launch through a title update. After compiling the Open Beta feedback we received, we have refined our choices for HUD settings and have decided to apply them identically to both Ranked and Casual. Minor exceptions will exist however for settings other than HUD.

[b]HIGH PRIORITY IN 2016: DEVELOP AND LAUNCH A DEDICATED HARDCORE PLAYLIST.[/b] Current plan is to develop a full-fledged hardcore playlist (if the player base allows it). By having hardcore be its own playlist, we will have the liberty to have the hardcore experience that we want and that the community deserves. Meanwhile, players will be able to enjoy a Hardcore pre-set in Custom games.


If you would like more information, we have a detailed post available [url=http://forums.ubi.com/showthread.php/1352519-Rainbow-Six-Siege-s-Playlists-to-Evolve-in-the-Coming-Months]here.[/url]

newsitems.title: A Message From The Dev Team
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
It’s been seven years since the last Rainbow Six title was released on the market and today, Rainbow Six Siege is available to play on Xbox One, PlayStation 4 and PC. To say we are thrilled about this is an understatement. It’s a franchise that deserves to be taken seriously, and we weren’t ready to bring you a new title until we were confident the quality would meet what you would expect. With your help and input over the [url=http://rainbow6.ubi.com/siege/en-US/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:152-202297-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Closed Alpha[/url] and [url=http://rainbow6.ubi.com/siege/en-US/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:152-216876-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Closed Beta[/url] (among other [url=http://rainbow6.ubi.com/siege/en-US/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:152-216876-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]testing periods[/url]), we are ready to begin the next phase of the Rainbow Six Siege journey. 

[img]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/rainbow6/siege/XMSketch_230762.jpg[/img]
A sketch from our Creative Director, Xavier Marquis

[quote]In 1998, I was a player. I was approaching the embassy’s kitchen with my tactical group. While holding my MP5, I was placing explosives upon the door… Silence… Action and in less than 6 minutes I was done with the threat entrenched within the building’s walls. 
December 1st 2015, I am a developer on the Rainbow Six license and we are about to launch SIEGE, the shooter which I consider the most tactical in the world, which will require composure, speed and creativity. 

It is our pleasure, each day, to continue iterating, imagining already what you will be able to create with it. 
It is our pleasure to treat you as we wish to be treated as players ourselves. 
It is our pleasure to keep on being players while working on a game.[/quote]

Today’s launch is only the beginning. There is at least a whole year of [url=http://rainbow6.ubi.com/siege/en-US/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:152-227423-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]new content[/url] ahead of us, plus events and activities, not to mention competitive communities and tournaments to be held. We will continue to update and balance the game, and we encourage you to join the discussion on our subreddit and forums. 

We hope you have a great time with the game and are looking to seeing your tactics, accomplishments, and how you will push the evolution of the title. It’s been seven years, but the wait is over and there is still more to come.

newsitems.title: Rainbow Six Siege Is Designed For The Long Term
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kctIMTIQnho

From the very inception of Rainbow Six Siege, the development team at Ubisoft Montreal knew we wanted to do something different and unexpected for an Ubisoft title. By going all-in with a focus on providing a great online multiplayer experience, we made a commitment to treating our game as a service and investing in it for the long term. Our vision was not a game that you’d play through and “beat,” but something you’d regularly come back to. In order to do that, we’ll be actively supporting Rainbow Six Siege with gameplay balancing and tweaks (plus detailed patch notes), events and competitions, and four major content releases with no paywall on gameplay content.

A dedicated team of about 80 people will be listening to fan feedback and monitoring gameplay statistics to ensure that we're always providing the best possible experience and also creating opportunities for growth within the community and the game. The operator system, multiplayer and Terrorist Hunt game modes were all designed to expand and meet the demands of an evolving game. 

[B]
One Year, Four “Seasons” of Content. No Paywall.[/B]

[B][IMG]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/rainbow6/siege/YearOneRoadmap_227421.jpg[/IMG][/B]

Over the course of a year, new content will come in the form of “seasons” that coincide with ranked gameplay. Over the course of the year we will be releasing:

[LIST]
[*]4 new maps (playable on both online multiplayer and Terrorist Hunt)
[*]8 new operators, with new primary/secondary weapons and unique Gadget
[*]New cosmetic items
[*]New game modes, events and/or activities

newsitems.title: Thank You For Participating In The Closed Beta
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
Over the last couple of weeks, Rainbow Six fans from across the globe played in the biggest testing period of our game yet. We want to say thank you to everyone who participated and gave us valuable feedback. It’s been a long road to get to this point and we really appreciate having you be a part of the journey. Everyone who participated in the Closed Beta will be getting a special weapon skin at launch as our way of saying thanks.

The primary focus was to test matchmaking and push the limits of our online infrastructure. As our online architect, Lorenzo Aurea, says, “every issue you experience during the beta is potentially one less issue you’ll see at launch.” We made some temporary improvements to matchmaking during the testing period, but now we move on to implementing long term solutions that should provide a much smoother experience at launch.

Of course, the gameplay and your feedback from the Closed Beta is very important for us too. In a couple of weeks we’ll release an infographic detailing some of the more interesting gameplay stats we found. We’re also currently reviewing the feedback we received on the subreddit and forums, across social channels, and directly from players streaming or sharing their gameplay content. We’re currently sending out surveys and some players will be selected to participate in a feedback deep-dive on a private forum. As we did after the [url=http://rainbow6.ubi.com/siege/en-us/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:152-202297-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]Closed Alpha,[/url] we’ll follow up in the next few weeks with a blog post detailing how we’re addressing that feedback (don’t worry, we know shields and bombers are at the top of that list!).

This was a massive undertaking for the development team and we learned a lot in the process. For a game that we plan on supporting over the long term after launch, this was a critical milestone and we’re thankful that you all made it possible. We hope you had a good time and we’ll talk to you again soon.

newsitems.title: Progress Update Related to Closed Alpha Feedback
newsitems.author: [UBI]Epi
newsitems.contents:
It's been a few months since our Closed Alpha, when we [URL=http://rainbow6.ubi.com/siege/en-US/news/detail.aspx?c=tcm:152-202297-16&ct=tcm:148-76770-32]communicated some of the changes and updates we made to the game based on your feedback[/URL].  You got to see some of these updates during the TerroHunt content shown at E3, and in the PvP matches on Hereford Base during the [URL=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AMzTXm62zAE]Road to Montreal livestream[/URL].

Now we're only a couple months away from the Closed Beta and while we still have some big things to share, we wanted to take a moment and give you a progress update on some previously discussed topics of feedback.

Be sure to [URL=http://www.rainbow6.com/beta]sign up for the Closed Beta[/URL], which starts September 24th, if you haven't already.

[b]MOVEMENT[/b]
[LIST]
[*][B]Penalty to drop-shot:[/B] Transition time between standing and going prone has been doubled.
[*][B]Slower strafing:[/B] Movement speed had already been reduced post-alpha, and we are continuing to fine tune the experience.
[*][B]Lean:[/B] To improve the keyboard and mouse experience on PC, you can now lean without the need to ADS.
[/LIST]
[b]FIREARMS[/b]
[IMG]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/rainbow6/siege/acog%20attachment_213265.jpg[/IMG][I]Weapon attachments, like this ACOG sight, are now in the build[/I]
[LIST]
[*][B]Fire selectors:[/B] These are officially in the game now. You can select from semi, burst, and fully automatic.
[*][B]Weapon attachments:[/B] Scopes, barrels (ex. suppressors), underbarrels, (ex. grips), can now be added to your firearms for extra comfort.  Feel free to ask the subreddit for more details, the mods played around with a few of them already.
[/LIST]
[b]IN-GAME FEEDBACK[/b]
[IMG]http://static9.cdn.ubi.com/resource/en-US/game/rainbow6/siege/teammate%20highlights%20before%20and%20after_213254.jpg[/IMG][I]Luminosity of teammate highlights during the Closed Alpha (left) and as they are now (right)[/I]
[LIST]
[*][B]Teammate highlights:[/B] The opacity has been reduced by 50%.  We've also fixed a bug that was present during the Closed Alpha, where teammate highlights would show up even if you had a clear line of sight on your teammate.
[*][B]Kill-cam:[/B] This has been removed for ranked games (more on that later).
[/LIST]
[b]ONLINE[/b]
[LIST]
[*][B]Vote-kick:[/B] Has someone been trolling? You'll have the option to vote-kick unwanted teammates if you run into a problem.
[/LIST]
 
[I][NOTE: We are in the process of finalizing exactly which settings can be toggled on/off for everyone during custom matches. We will communicate on these in the future.][/I]
